description: This file defines models and a fetcher for retrieving and processing historical EPS data from AlphaVantage API, including query parameters, data validation, and async data fetching logic.

classes.name: AlphaVantageHistoricalEpsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching historical EPS data from AlphaVantage, including period and limit options.

classes.name: AlphaVantageHistoricalEpsData
classes.description: Represents the structure of historical EPS data with validation and normalization logic.

classes.name: AVHistoricalEpsFetcher
classes.description: Handles asynchronous fetching of EPS data from AlphaVantage API, including request transformation and data processing.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts generic query parameters into AlphaVantage-specific query parameters.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Performs asynchronous API requests to retrieve EPS data for specified symbols.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API response data into structured AlphaVantageHistoricalEpsData instances.
